claims.statement: The business operates under the name Boise Metal Works and has been operating since 1994.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Since 1994. High-Quality Metal Fabrication in Boise, Idaho and Surrounding Areas

claims.statement: Boise Metal Works is located at 2000 Yamhill Rd., Boise, ID 83716.
claims.label: fact

claims.statement: Boise Metal Works was founded in 1994 by [redacted] and [redacted], originating from the [redacted] family's Boise Spring Works founded in 1917.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Boise Metal Works was spawned from Boise Spring Works , which had been founded by [redacted] in 1917.

claims.statement: The company serves Boise, the Treasure Valley communities of Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, and Caldwell, as well as Eastern Oregon.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: We have been serving Boise, Idaho including the Treasure Valley Communities of Meridian, Eagle, Nampa – Caldwell and Eastern Oregon since 1994.

activities: Custom metal fabrication for commercial, industrial, and residential applications
Custom metal railing, stairs, gates, fences, awnings, and signs
Custom truck accessories and fabricated steel tanks
Product development, value engineering, and manufacturing runs
CNC machining and CNC water jet cutting
In-house painting and partnered powder coating

claims.statement: Boise Metal Works provides custom metal fabrication and manufacturing solutions for commercial, industrial, and residential applications.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Boise Metal Works provides custom metal fabrication and manufacturing solutions for commercial, industrial, and residential applications.

claims.statement: The company provides structural steel fabrication, including main structural members, stairways, safety bollards, steel concrete embeds, and OSHA guards, rails, ladders, and platforms.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Boise Metal Works provides structural steel fabrication, everything for your structural steel projects, from the main structural members down to the miscellaneous items

claims.statement: The company offers value engineering and manufacturing support for general contractors, entrepreneurs, and competitors.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Boise Metal Works provides value engineering services to General Contractors and entrepreneurs which allows for options within the metal fabrication work scope

claims.statement: Boise Metal Works is a metal fabrication and manufacturing business rather than an HVAC, plumbing, or electrical home-service contractor.
claims.label: inference

claims.statement: The company's public website lists a base shop rate of $95 per hour, separate from machining and water jet rates.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Our shop rate is $95 an hour and is subject to change. This is separate from our machining and water jet rates.

claims.statement: The shop's stated equipment includes steel shearing and forming machines, a 110-ton iron worker, a Vf4 CNC machine, and a 9' x 13' CNC water jet machine.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: We can cut up to 12′ of Mild Steel. We have a table size of 9′ x 13′.

claims.statement: Each customer is assigned a dedicated point of contact from design through delivery.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Your dedicated, Boise Metal Works point of contact is committed for the life of your project, from design to delivery.

claims.statement: The structural steel page states that the company has experienced and certified welders and technicians for on-site fabrication, repairs, and maintenance.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Experienced & certified welders and technicians for on-site fabrication, repairs and maintenance.

claims.statement: The FAQ page references commercial and residential building code specifications for stair rise and handrail dimensions.
claims.label: fact
claims.quote: Maximum rise is 7″ per commercial code 7 1/4″ per residential code.

licensing.limitations: No state contractor license numbers, business registration numbers, or specific welding certification identifiers are published on the pages read.

problems.problem: Supplier material invoices and job costing across custom fabrication, machining, water jetting, and partnered powder coating may involve manual data entry.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The company performs multi-step custom fabrication and works with external powder coating partners, though its internal ERP or accounting software is not visible on the website.

risks.description: Custom metal fabrication and structural steel quoting require engineering, building code, and material inspection judgment that differs fundamentally from standardized home-service contractor dispatch workflows.

assumptions: Although the FAQ page states a base shop rate of $95 per hour (excluding machining and water jet rates), no ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's target segment, and the site provides no inquiry volume or lead-loss metrics.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Verified business identity, location, phone number, principal metal fabrication activities, and website scripts/forms.
Company founding history (1994) and founders [redacted] and [redacted].
Service area, physical address, phone contact channel, and project inquiry form with file upload.

limitations: Employee headcount is not stated on the website.
Current active executive/management titles beyond the 1994 founding history of [redacted] and [redacted] are not detailed on the website.
Internal accounting, ERP, CAD, or estimating software names are not disclosed on the public pages.
Whether the company pays for digital leads is not observable from the pages read.
State contractor license numbers and business registration details are not listed on the website.

qualification.rationale: ForgeX's target segment is owner-led home-service contractors in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical with 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Boise Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication, structural steel, machining, and manufacturing job shop serving commercial, industrial, and residential clients. Because it operates outside ForgeX's core home-service trade segment, it is not a fit.
